svg.text: Every week, millions of AI credits expire unused. Claude Pro sessions, Gemini subscriptions, Copilot seats —
capacity that evaporates the moment it isn't used. Hee-Lee Oss gives that capacity a purpose.
Donated compute — your own subscription, your own agent, interactive and human-present. Free. Hee-Lee Oss
never touches your credentials or runs anything on your behalf.
